# FilterMenu

```ts
import { FilterMenu } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The multi-select menu behind one filter in the Filter Bar (Figma hellopc.table.filter.menu, node 18259:2253), e.g. "OS type". Its trigger reads as an outline Button until the filter is applied, then turns tonal and shows the selection — "OS type: 2 selected", or the value itself when only one is picked. Use it for filters over a known, short list of values; for conditions ("Last seen before…"), use the Filter Rule Builder.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | **required** | The filter's name — the trigger text and the panel's accessible name (e.g. "OS type"). |
| `options` | `FilterMenuOption[]` | **required** | One checkbox row per value. |
| `value` | `string[]` | — | Controlled applied selection (option values). |
| `defaultValue` | `string[]` | `[]` | Uncontrolled initial applied selection. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string[]) => void` | — | Fires with the new selection when the user presses Done. |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` | ``Search ${label}`` | Search field placeholder. |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Controlled open state of the panel. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — | Fires when the panel opens or closes. |
| `maxListHeight` | `number \| string` | — | Caps the option list height and scrolls it; omit to show every option. |


## Usage

```tsx
<FilterMenu label="OS type" options={osTypes} />
<FilterMenu label="OS type" options={osTypes} defaultValue={['win11', 'win10']} />
<FilterMenu label="Status" options={statuses} value={status} onValueChange={setStatus} />
<FilterMenu label="Model" options={models} maxListHeight={288} />
<FilterMenu label="OS type" options={osTypes} searchPlaceholder="Find an OS" />
```

## Accessibility

- The trigger is a real Button with aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; the panel is a labelled dialog ("OS type filter"). Focus moves to the search field on open and returns to the trigger on close.
- Each row is one checkbox (role="checkbox", aria-checked); "Select all" reports aria-checked="mixed" when partial. Counts are part of the row name ("Windows 11, 812").
- The "n of N selected" summary and "No matches" are role="status", so changes are announced as you tick boxes or search.
- Clear is disabled while nothing is picked; Esc cancels without applying.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Keep the label short — it becomes "Label: 2 selected" | Put the selection summary in the label yourself |
| Show counts when they help people choose | Show counts that don't match the current table data |
| Apply on Done, so the table re-queries once | Re-filter the table on every tick |
| Use the Filter Rule Builder for conditions and ranges | Stretch this menu into a free-form query editor |
